subject: Azure offer publish: tenant identity proofing + technical gating checklist
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Azure Marketplace Team <marketplace-team@microsoft.com>, Sarah Blake <sarah.blake@contoso.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure offer publish: tenant identity proofing + technical gating checklist

Hi team,

We’re preparing to publish our Redwood Inference offer targeting Contoso (see CC). Before we submit the manifest, we want to confirm the identity proofing steps and the technical validation gate so there are no surprises. High-level asks: 

- Which tenant-level documents are required for publisher verification beyond the company registration PDF? (we’ve attached the company identity PDF).
- Any preflight checks on the ARM manifest or SKU mapping you recommend to avoid a technical rejection?
- Are there specific telemetry/monitoring fields (SaaS integration points) the validation team looks for in the offer artifacts?

I’ve attached: redwood_publisher_identity.pdf and a first-draft of offer_manifest_v1.zip.

Goal: submit by end of day Friday if we can resolve identity proofing and a short tech checklist. Contoso is expecting a co-sell-ready listing; we want to avoid back-and-forth.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Director, Partnerships (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference
---
Attachments (stubs): redwood_publisher_identity.pdf (identity proof), offer_manifest_v1.zip (manifest + README)

From: Azure Marketplace Team <marketplace-team@microsoft.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Blake <sarah.blake@contoso.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure offer publish: tenant identity proofing + technical gating checklist

Hi Alex / team,

Thanks for the early heads-up — happy to help. Quick answers and next steps: 

1) Identity proofing: we require a signed company registration + a primary contact verification (phone + corporate email) and a government-issued proof for the signer in some cases. Your redwood_publisher_identity.pdf is a good start; please also include a signed W-8/W-9 equivalent if Contoso will be transacting on the listing.

2) Manifest preflight: common rejection triggers we see:
  - Missing SaaS planResourceId in the plan definitions.
  - Invalid SKU mapping for VM sizes (if you reference specific VM SKUs, include fallback ranges).
  - Incomplete publisherProfile or supportContact blocks.

3) Telemetry/monitoring: validation looks for a support URL, a logging/ops contact, and a basic health-check endpoint for SaaS offers. If you have an onboarding script or ARM template that creates Service Principals, include a short README describing least-privilege scopes.

Action: We can run a 30-min pre-validation on Monday — please confirm if you want the team to validate the attached manifest. Also, upload the identity doc to the publisher portal (https://publisher.azure.com/organizations/redwood-inference) and paste the link here so we avoid email attachments for PII.

Regards,
Azure Marketplace Validation Team
Marketplace Program Manager
Azure
---
Note: we will send DocuSign for publisher signature where required.

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 12:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure offer publish: tenant identity proofing + technical gating checklist

Alex — noted. Karthik, can you take the manifest preflight? Things to prioritize: 

- Confirm planResourceId present and that our ARM template exposes configurable VM sizes (don’t hardcode dsv3-8-to-16; instead accept size ranges).
- Add supportContact and ops-health endpoints to the manifest README.
- Prepare a short README for the SP (Service Principal) creation used by Contoso onboarding with minimum permissions.

I’ll upload the redwood_publisher_identity.pdf to the publisher portal and generate the Share link. Alex — I’ll also prepare a redacted W-9 copy if needed.

Deliverables by Monday 9am PT so we can take the pre-validation slot.

- Lauren
Head of GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

Please upload the manifest to the portal prior to the call and paste the link in this thread. We will also send a DocuSign for the publisher signature (expect email from docusign@example.com).

Best,
Priya (on behalf of Azure Marketplace Validation)
